latestVersion.changelog: Initial release. bun-do is a local-first todo app (npm: bun-do, GitHub: github.com/ricardofrantz/bun-do) that acts as a task backend for OpenClaw agents. This skill exposes the REST API for managing tasks, subtasks, recurring payments, and project progress logs — all persisted to local JSON files. Also ships as an MCP server (bun-do-mcp).
